test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_fixed_size_full (id UInt64, fs FixedString(16), d64 Decimal64(4), d128 Decimal128(10)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 1
CREATE TABLE test_fixed_size_sparse (id UInt64, fs FixedString(16), d64 Decimal64(4), d128 Decimal128(10)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.8
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_fixed_size_{serialization} SELECT number, number % 10 = 0 ? toFixedString(concat('k', toString(intHash64(number) % 1000)), 16) : toFixedString('', 16), number % 10 = 0 ? toDecimal64(intHash64(number) % 1000 + 1, 4) : toDecimal64(0, 4), number % 10 = 0 ? toDecimal128(intHash64(number) % 1000 + 1, 10) : toDecimal128(0, 10) FROM numbers(100000000)
test.query: SELECT fs, count() FROM test_fixed_size_{serialization} GROUP BY fs FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM test_fixed_size_{serialization} WHERE bitNot(fs) != bitNot(toFixedString('', 16))
SELECT d64, count() FROM test_fixed_size_{serialization} GROUP BY d64 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM test_fixed_size_{serialization} WHERE d64 + 1 > 500
SELECT count() FROM test_fixed_size_{serialization} WHERE d128 + 1 > 500
